method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 注意到 Eeling 冒雨来访，比上次来得晚，且眼睛血丝密布、带着酒气。
facts.anchor: Hattie checks the time, noting he’s later than the prior visit.

facts.fact: Eeling 问 Hattie 是否在 Tommy 因谋杀罪被起诉后雇了私家侦探。
facts.anchor: You hired a private detective after Tommy was indicted for the murders, correct?

facts.fact: Hattie 说在审判七个月的煎熬中，私家侦探得出了和警方相同的结论。
facts.anchor: He came to the same conclusion the cops did.

facts.fact: Hattie 联系了所有受害者家属并向他们道歉，但没有人回应。
facts.anchor: I reached out to all of their families. Told them how sorry I was.

facts.fact: Hattie 说 Ed 比她更早不再相信 Tommy。
facts.anchor: Ed quit believing him much sooner than I did.

facts.fact: Hattie 说 Colm 在 Tommy 被判有罪后仍坚持去探监。
facts.anchor: Colm kept visiting Tommy even after he was found guilty.

facts.fact: Eeling 指出 Leah 因怀着 Tommy 的孩子而最久相信他无辜。
facts.anchor: Because she was carrying his child.

facts.fact: Hattie 从 Eeling 手指上的戒指印记推断他已婚并且在进来前摘掉了戒指。
facts.anchor: there’s an outline of a ring on your finger

facts.fact: Hattie 说自己怨恨 Ed，因为他比她更早、在她准备好之前面对了现实。
facts.anchor: and then because he’d faced reality before I could.
